name_note: Some sources abbreviate the species name as A colihominis; nearly all genomes GTDB places here carry the NCBI name Anaerotruncus.

sentences.text: The genus Anaerotruncus was created for Anaerotruncus colihominis, a Gram-positive, anaerobic, non-spore-forming, rod-shaped bacterium isolated from human faeces.
Those isolates were catalase-negative and produced acetic and butyric acids as end products of metabolism.
A clinical report described a case of Anaerotruncus colihominis bacteraemia in a 78-year-old woman, and proposed spore formation as an emended description of the species.
A multi-omic study reported enrichment of Anaerotruncus colihominis in patients with obesity-related depression compared with healthy individuals.
